//: Add this block to the 'platforms' array of your Homebridge config.json.
//install: 1) Install the plugin homebridge-camera-ffmpeg. 2) Replace <CameraName> with the RTSP path avent-login.py printed. 3) Replace __INSTALL_DIR__. 4) Restart Homebridge, then add the camera manually in the Home app (see README).
name: Camera FFmpeg
//videoProcessor: The static ffmpeg from scripts/get-ffmpeg.sh (has libfdk_aac for audio + hardware accel). Never use the Homebrew ffmpeg in PATH.

cameras.name: Baby Camera
cameras.//unbridge: REQUIRED. Cameras are published as separate accessories you add manually in the Home app.

videoConfig.//source: Input low-latency flags shave the A/V offset. Keep re-encode: do NOT use vcodec 'copy' (the source has occasional corrupt slices + irregular keyframes, so copy freezes until the next keyframe).
videoConfig.//vcodec: h264_videotoolbox on macOS (hardware). On Linux use 'libx264'. -realtime/-bf 0 + short GOP keep latency low and emit regular keyframes.
